title: “Just Words? Just Speeches?” On the Economic Value of Charismatic Leadership
eligible_reason: Randomized field and laboratory experiments with cross-sectional treatment comparisons (charismatic vs standard speech, piece rate). The only 'diff-in-diff' is an interaction of the charisma dummy with experiment dummies in pooled lab regressions (Table 5), not a panel adoption design.
design_notes: Field experiment: 106 temporary workers in 15 randomly treated sessions (baseline, piece rate, charisma); outcome is envelopes completed. Lab experiments 1-3: speeches then repeated public goods game. Table 5 pooled OLS/Tobit with Charisma x Experiment interactions and session-clustered SEs. No staggered adoption, no unit and calendar-time FE structure.
estimators_reported: Fisher exact and other non-parametric tests
screener_notes: Not eligible: randomized experiments. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only.
